#### Get Started

# Do I have to switch? What happens if I don't?

This article covers Individual and eligible self-serve Team plans. Enterprise uses a separate process.

Switching is optional. If you don’t switch, your current plan continues unless you change or cancel it.

## What happens if I don't switch?

* Your current plan continues.
* You can change or cancel your plan through the options currently available to you.

## What happens if I switch?

To switch, see [How to unify accounts under The X Subscription](/x-subscription/unify-accounts).

A completed switch is permanent and cannot be undone by Support.

## Payments

You can pay by card or another supported payment method (see [Which payment methods can I use?](/x-subscription/payment-methods)).

## If Unify is unavailable

* Pay any unpaid invoice or past-due balance, then try again.
* Accounts billed by invoice can’t use the self-serve flow.
* Enterprise customers should contact their account team.
